direction: Distinct specialist subjects; shared palette and editorial linework

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished standalone illustration for EquipED, a university academic evaluation workbench. Editorial vector-like object/scene illustration, NOT an app screenshot, NOT an icon, NOT a diagram board with labels. 3:2 landscape, entire subject fully visible, transparent background. Strong distinctive silhouette readable at 400px. Refined solid geometric fills and slender consistent blue outlines, some discreet cut-paper layering, no photorealism, no plastic clay, no glow, no blurry backdrop shadows. Palette: royal blue #1b3b87, deep blue #142f70, paper white #fbfcfc, cool gray #cad6da, slate #91a5ad, ink #1b2b33, amber #d9ad1d as a small focal accent. Cohesive sophisticated academic publication art. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or score charts. No stack of large upright manuscripts, NO long folded ribbon behind the scene. No repeated generic document-with-annotation silhouette. The identity comes from blue linework, paper tones, thoughtful composition and small amber details, not an identical object arrangement. Compose real recognizable things rather than pure abstract shapes. Clean transparent alpha and generous clear margin.
SUBJECT MATTER EXPERT: A large elegant circular optical inspection lens supported by a small angled articulated stand occupies the upper right, hovering above ONE horizontal academic proof sheet lying on a shallow slanted reading surface. Through the lens, a small geometric teaching diagram on the proof becomes visibly clearer and larger. The sheet has only a few short print rules and a small amber passage; it is secondary in size to the lens. At lower left, two slim CLOSED reference books lie horizontally with their spines facing outward, accompanied by a blue annotation pencil. Visually create a circular lens plus low horizontal research-desk silhouette, a careful scholarly close-reading scene. No graduation cap, shield, speech bubbles, people, giant upright page or ribbon. The lens is a carefully illustrated optical object with depth at its rim, not a stock magnifying-glass icon.
